**Spec — P2: Failed dashboard refresh exposes the previous control directory’s drafts.**

Locations: `src/ergora/data/console/app.js:34`, `:76–80`, `:153–165`; consuming path at `src/ergora/data/console/workflow.js:132`, `:145–149`, `:226–229`.

Trigger: load project P from home A, restart the same HTTP address using home B containing project P, then refresh. Bootstrap B succeeds, but its dashboard request fails. `app.bootstrap` now identifies B while `app.data` still contains A. The catch handler renders that combination because rendering checks only whether data exists. Opening a listed A draft registers its contents and revision in B’s editor namespace. A subsequent save reaches B and can overwrite B’s corresponding draft when revisions match.

The new `dataControlDirectory` guard protects dashboard merging, but does not prevent this mismatched rendering. Smallest correction: in the existing refresh owner, clear and synchronously hide retained data when the successful bootstrap identifies a different directory, before awaiting its dashboard. Preserve A’s editor buffers and show the existing loading/error view until B’s data succeeds. Extend the existing directory-switch probe with dashboard failure and draft-opening attempts.

This finding follows from source inspection; I did not execute a reproduction. The R6 source and attached results address the original S5–S7 orderings, but those results do not cover this interaction during failed refresh.

**Standards:** No separate confirmed defect. Existing callback interfaces remain stable. Session, history and layout helpers appropriately stay private to `workflow.js`; dashboard installation remains in `app.js`. Cytoscape, `drafts.save` and `reference.validate_input` retain their responsibilities. The bounded private history serves a concrete local need; C3 provides no second consumer warranting extraction. No new dependency, schema, CI job or mirrored permanent test appears.

Attached validation records 22 checks passing in 13.28 seconds plus browser/history/quota results. These support their recorded scope, without establishing general responsiveness or C6 capacity. Remaining delivery gates stay separate.
